item.title: [MEDIUM] Apple iCloud Private Relay Can Expose Real IPs Through WebKit Proxy Bypasses
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed a security issue with Apple's iCloud Private Relay tool that can expose a user's real IP address. Introduced with iOS 15, iCloud Private Relay employs a dual-hop architecture to ensure users' privacy by routing their Safari web traffic through two relays so that no single third-party, including Apple, can determine where the request is originating from
